ADR training

Training for drivers who carry dangerous goods by road.

In plain English

ADR is the training associated with carrying dangerous goods by road. The course you need depends on what you carry and how it is carried, so we confirm the right one with you before you book.

Who it is for

Drivers who need ADR training for the work they do. Whether that is an initial course or a refresher, and which classes apply, is confirmed when you enquire.

What it covers

  • Training towards carrying dangerous goods by road, in the form the course actually covers

The right course depends on the classes of goods you carry and whether they travel in packages or in tanks. We confirm this when you enquire.

Eligibility and prerequisites

A general guide. We check your own licence when you enquire.

  • A driving entitlement suited to the vehicle being used
  • A clear idea of which classes of dangerous goods you carry
  • We help you confirm whether ADR applies to the work you do

What the training includes

  • A clear explanation of who the course is for
  • Initial or refresher training, confirmed when you enquire
  • The classes of dangerous goods the course covers
  • Classroom training at our Bristol base

How the course works

  1. Enquire about ADR

    Say what you carry, or that you are not sure which class applies.

  2. Confirm the course type

    Initial or refresher, packages or tanks, and the classes you need. We agree these with you before you book.

  3. Attend the course

    Classroom training at the base that runs the course.

  4. Ask about the certificate

    We explain how your certificate is issued when you enquire.

Training format

Classroom course at our Bristol base. We confirm dates when you enquire.

Duration and cost

We confirm the length of the course and the next available dates when you enquire.

We confirm the fee when you enquire, along with the dates available.

Why train here

  • Clear about each course

    We explain who a course is for, what it leads to and how it runs before you are asked to commit to anything.

  • Courses matched to the right base

    Each course page shows which of our bases run it, so you only see training you can actually take.

  • Practical and classroom routes

    Licence training is time in the vehicle. Driver CPC, ADR and Operator CPC are classroom courses, each with its own page.

  • A straightforward enquiry

    Tell us the course, your preferred base and how to reach you. An enquiry does not book a test or commit you to anything.

Questions about this course

Who needs ADR training?

Drivers who carry dangerous goods by road. The course you need depends on the classes of goods and whether they travel in packages or in tanks, and we confirm this when you enquire.
